mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals monetary easing, which compresses discount rates on equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 5-day forward returns despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2% for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market strength, reducing labor costs for firms and increasing corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 20-day forward returns despite UNRATE falling below 4.5% for the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index signals robust supply-side activity, stimulating corporate investment and consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 60-day forward returns despite INDPRO increasing for the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and demand for goods (RSAFS) signals robust demand-side activity, amplifying corporate profits and equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 20-day forward returns despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS remaining above their respective thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS below 2%) and weakening labor market (UNRATE falling below 6%) creates synergistic effects, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 60-day forward returns despite FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE < 6.0% for the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the industrial production index above 100 signals robust supply-side activity, stimulating corporate investment and consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 20-day forward returns despite INDPRO exceeding 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, monetary easing (FEDFUNDS below 2%) is expected to amplify positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 60-day forward returns during a late-cycle expansion despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 20,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 5-day forward returns despite GDPC1 exceeding 20,000.
